summary: GigCapital7 Corp. filed an 8-K reporting results of an extraordinary general meeting held May 7, 2026. Shareholders approved the business combination with Hadron Energy, Inc. (domestication from Cayman to Delaware, merger of Merger Sub into Hadron, issuance of up to ~60M post-combination shares to Hadron equity holders as consideration). Proposals passed overwhelmingly (e.g., ~19.7M for, ~1.1M against, 10K abstain on the business combination). The filing also covers approval of interim governing documents and a new certificate of incorporation. This is the final shareholder approval step before closing the de-SPAC transaction. Watch for the closing announcement and Nasdaq listing of combined entity shares. Risk-arb investors monitor regulatory clearance and any redemption activity.
